KERNEL PRIME’26 — THE CORE OF INNOVATION
About the Hackathon
KERNEL PRIME’26 — The Core of Innovation is a 
24-hour offline hackathon
 organized by the 
Department of Electronics and Communication Engineering & Electronics Engineering (VLSI Design & Technology), S.A. Engineering College, Chennai-77
.
The hackathon brings together engineering students to transform ideas into practical solutions through innovation, technical skills, problem-solving and teamwork.
Date:
 October 8 & 9, 2026
Duration:
 24 Hours
Team Size:
 2–4 Members
Tracks:
 Hardware & Software
Prize Pool:
 ₹50,000
Mode:
 Offline / On-Campus
Eligibility
• Open to engineering students from colleges/institutions.

• Each team must have 
2–4 members
.

• 
Inter-college teams are not allowed
; all members must belong to the same institution.

• Inter-department / inter-specialization teams within the same institution are allowed.

• Each participant can register with only one team.
Tracks
Hardware Track:
 Electronics, embedded systems, IoT, automation, robotics and related technologies. Hardware Problem Statements will be released 
one day before the hackathon
. Participants must bring their own required components and equipment.
Software Track:
 Software development, web/mobile applications, AI/ML, automation, cybersecurity and related technologies.
Only 
one track
 can be selected per team. Projects must be relevant to the selected track. Opposite-track projects will not be considered.
Open Innovation — Initial Screening
Teams must submit an 
Open Innovation Project Proposal
 consisting of:
• Project Title

• Brief Project Description

• Selected Track

• Open Innovation PPT (
maximum 6 slides
)
The proposal will be used for the 
initial screening and shortlisting
 of teams. Submission does not guarantee selection.
Registration Fee
Initial registration is free.
A 
₹1,000 registration fee per team
 will be applicable only to 
shortlisted teams after selection and confirmation
 of participation in the offline hackathon.
Hackathon Format
• The hackathon will be conducted for 
24 hours
.

• Selected teams will work on the designated Problem Statement for their chosen track.

• The event will include 
three evaluation stages
.

• Teams will be evaluated on problem understanding, innovation, technical implementation, functionality, feasibility, presentation and overall impact.

• Teams must complete and demonstrate their solution within the allotted time.
Rules
Each team must have 2–4 members.
All members must belong to the same college/institution.
Inter-college teams are not permitted.
Inter-department / inter-specialization teams are allowed within the same institution.
Each participant can register with only one team.
Each team can select only one track.
Teams must complete their solution within the 24-hour duration.
Teams must present and demonstrate their solution during the evaluation rounds.
Plagiarism, copying, cheating, impersonation or submission of another team's work will result in disqualification.
Hardware Track participants are responsible for bringing and safely handling their own components and equipment.
Participants must follow the instructions and regulations of the organizing committee and S.A. Engineering College.
The decision of the judging panel and organizing committee will be final.
Selection Process
Online Registration → Open Innovation Proposal Submission → Initial Screening → Shortlisting → Participation Confirmation & ₹1,000 Fee → Offline 24-Hour Hackathon
Only shortlisted and confirmed teams will be eligible to participate in the offline hackathon.
Think. Build. Innovate. Be the Core.
